message.content:
Design the implementation for consolidating InkOS's bottom-left sidebar account dropdown into the top-right avatar dropdown.

## Context
- Project: InkOS (Next.js 16.2.3, Supabase, Tailwind 4, shadcn/ui, Base UI DropdownMenu primitives). Brand: Bone/Onyx/Stone/Rust palette, Inter + Instrument Serif fonts.
- Current bottom-left: `components/app/sidebar/SidebarUserFooter.tsx` (224 lines). Menu: profile header (avatar, name, email, role), Account (My profile, Account settings), Workspace (Studio settings, Team, Billing, Integrations — owner/admin only), Appearance submenu (Light/Dark/System), Sign out (destructive).
- Current top-right: `components/app/sidebar/AppHeader.tsx` lines 375-467. Menu: avatar+ChevronDown trigger, w-56, Profile header, Profile, Settings, Theme submenu, Sign out.
- Mounted at `app/(app)/layout.tsx`. Mobile has separate MobileNav sheet + BottomNav (MobileNav currently has sign-out at its bottom).
- Sidebar header already has StudioSwitcher (multi-tenant workspace switcher) — this STAYS where it is per IA rules.
- DropdownMenu from `components/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx` (Base UI).
- Brand rules: Onyx primary text, Stone secondary, Rust for destructive/active only (once or twice per viewport). Tabular figures. Shadow tokens (`shadow-soft-md` / `shadow-lift` for popovers). No raw hex.

## Goal
1. Top-right becomes the SINGLE account dropdown. It inherits the full menu from SidebarUserFooter.
2. Bottom-left SidebarUserFooter is removed entirely (sidebar ends at nav groups + favorites).
3. MobileNav: ensure account actions (profile, account settings, workspace settings if owner/admin, appearance, sign out) stay accessible somewhere on mobile — recommend either mirroring in MobileNav footer or keeping existing sign-out + adding link to /settings.

## Requirements
- Preserve all existing role-gating (`canManageWorkspace = role === 'owner' || role === 'admin'`).
- Preserve sign-out handler (supabase.auth.signOut + redirect /login).
- Preserve Appearance submenu (next-themes integration).
- No duplicate menu paths — remove the trimmed version from AppHeader when installing the full one.
- Width: current w-56 is too tight for a rich identity header. Recommend w-72 (18rem).
- Identity header in the dropdown: avatar + STUDIO NAME (not user name) + email + role badge — exactly matches the user's screenshot. Studio name comes from active studio context. Need to wire this into AppHeader or create a new UserMenu component.
- Extract the dropdown into a reusable component `components/app/shell/UserMenu.tsx` (or similar) so AppHeader stays lean. Both desktop header + mobile MobileNav drawer can use it.
- Preserve keyboard nav, role-gated visibility, and all 5 icon/menu sections.
- Trigger on desktop: avatar h-9 w-9 + optional chevron (data-[popup-open]:rotate-180 animation already used).
- Trigger on mobile: avatar icon only.
- Follow InkOS brand rules — no raw hex, use semantic tokens, `shadow-soft-md` or similar for dropdown elevation, destructive uses `text-destructive` (Rust), no Tailwind default shadows.
- Since both headers pass `userName/userEmail/userAvatarUrl`, we also need `studioName` and `role` passed in (already loaded in layout.tsx for the active studio).

## Output needed
1. Exact file changes list:
   - NEW: `components/app/shell/UserMenu.tsx` — extracted account dropdown component
   - DELETE: `components/app/sidebar/SidebarUserFooter.tsx` (or mark deprecated, remove imports)
   - EDIT: `components/app/sidebar/AppSidebar.tsx` — remove SidebarFooter rendering of SidebarUserFooter
   - EDIT: `components/app/sidebar/AppHeader.tsx` — replace inline dropdown with `<UserMenu />`, pass studio context
   - EDIT: `app/(app)/layout.tsx` — ensure studio name + role are passed through to AppHeader/MobileNav (may already be)
   - EDIT: `components/shared/MobileNav.tsx` — mirror account menu entries in drawer footer (or link through to /settings for now)
2. The new `UserMenu` component's exact prop interface (userName, userEmail, userAvatarUrl, studioName, role, canManageWorkspace, onSignOut).
3. The dropdown structure with sections + separators + width + side/align.
4. Brand-compliance checklist (no raw hex, correct shadow tokens, destructive styling, tabular figures if any).
5. Verification steps (typecheck, build, visual check on desktop + mobile, role-gate toggle via different role users).

Keep plan concise and execution-ready. Flag any risks (e.g., MobileNav may need role prop added, AppHeader already loads role — verify).
